questions: Should the CLI pre-check feature flags or handle server errors reactively?
Where should the error handling for disabled Goals be placed in the CLI?
Should Goals commands be hidden from CLI help when the feature is disabled?

answers.answer: Reactive handling. The CLI should catch 404 errors from the server and display a user-friendly message. A pre-flight check adds latency (extra API call per command) and complexity. A CLI-side env var creates dual state. The server's 404 response with 'Goals feature is not available.' message flows through parseApiError naturally.
evidence: src/lib/http.ts:6 — RETRYABLE_STATUS_CODES = Set([429, 500, 502, 503, 504]) — 404 not retried, fails fast
src/goals/utils.ts:10-25 — parseApiError extracts .error from JSON body
src/lib/config.ts — CLI config has no feature flag env vars
Product spec: 'Server is the single source of truth'

answers.answer: A try/catch wrapper in runGoals (goals/index.ts) around the switch statement. This provides consistent error handling for all 5 commands. list.ts and get.ts lack local try/catch blocks and would otherwise show raw HTTP error format from the top-level handler. Commands with existing try/catch (create, terminate, resume) handle their own errors first via process.exit(1).
evidence: src/goals/index.ts:20-91 — runGoals switch dispatches with no wrapper catch
src/goals/list.ts — No try/catch, errors propagate to top-level
src/goals/get.ts:88-98 — No try/catch, errors propagate to top-level
src/goals/create.ts:54-70 — Has local try/catch with parseApiError and process.exit(1)
src/index.ts:157-160 — Top-level catch shows raw error.message

answers.answer: No. Goals commands should remain visible in help and documentation regardless of server flag state. The CLI doesn't know the server's feature state until a request is made. Removing commands from help would require a pre-flight check adding latency. Clear server-side error messages are sufficient.
evidence: src/docs/cli-content.ts:133-176 — Full docs for all goals commands
Product spec diagnosis: 'Goals commands remain in CLI help/docs'
src/goals/index.ts:9-17 — goalsUsage function shows all commands

statement: The CLI needs a try/catch wrapper in runGoals (goals/index.ts) that catches errors from all 5 subcommands and uses parseApiError to display user-friendly messages. When the server returns 404 'Goals feature is not available.', the CLI displays this cleanly. No pre-flight check, no CLI-side flag state, no new dependencies. One file changed.
